evidence.review: Whole timeconv source read and authored in ten separate stages: epoch/tm conventions, signed-day correction, offset normalization, weekday modulo, March calendar, unsigned epoch shift, century/year product, leap centuries, month product and final Gregorian/yday restoration. 1514922 independent 400-year/year/month-loop comparisons passed optimized and ASan/UBSan, fulls64 random + boundaries with extremeintoffset on long64. No native32 ABI/timezone/DST/leapsecond proof. Primary algorithm https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.06959 Proposition6.3 read.
